basic_info.description: Welcome to 1277 Cayuga Avenue in the sought-after Cayuga Terrace Neighborhood! This spacious 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers plenty of room for living and entertaining. On the main level, you'll find three bedrooms and two bathrooms, a formal dining room, and an updated kitchen with a cozy eat-in dining area. The living room is bathed in natural light thanks to its beautiful arched windows, creating an inviting and open space. The home's detached layout on one side allows for west-facing windows that capture stunning afternoon light.    Downstairs, enjoy two additional bedrooms and a full bath, with convenient access to the backyard that is ready for your green thumb! The entire home has been updated with new paint and modern light fixtures throughout, adding a fresh and contemporary feel.    The garage provides side-by-side parking, plus a bonus storage/office room and a full laundry room perfect for staying organized. Outside, the low-maintenance backyard includes a retractable fence that allows for convenient large vehicle storage when needed. With its thoughtful layout, updated features, and excellent location, this home is truly a must-see. Schedule a tour today!
